assumptions: The closest human V and J by identity are a suitable acceptor.
limits: The classical route: it does not predict whether binding survives the graft.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which human germline framework accepts this domain's CDRs, and what is the grafted sequence?

description: Humanize an antibody variable domain by CDR grafting: find the closest human germline V and J, merge them into an acceptor framework, and put the parental CDRs onto it. The classical humanization route, and the counterpart to humanize_antibody's language model. Reproduces abnumber 0.4.4 over every antibody chain of ANARCI's PDB benchmark.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

backmutateVernier.description: keep the parental residues at the Kabat Vernier positions, the framework residues that support the CDR loops.

cdrDefinition.description: which CDR definition decides what is grafted from the parental antibody. Values: imgt (IMGT), kabat (Kabat), chothia (Chothia), north (North).

domain.description: which variable domain to graft when the sequence holds several (0-based, in sequence order).

jGene.description: use this human J germline instead of the closest one.

protein.description: the protein sequence (one-letter amino acids); the variable domains in it are found and numbered first.

rankByFrameworks.description: rank germlines on framework identity alone, ignoring the CDRs.

top.description: graft onto the n-th closest germline instead of the closest (0-based).

vGene.description: use this human V germline instead of the closest one (a family, gene or allele: IGHV1, IGHV1-18, IGHV1-18*01).

name: graft_antibody_cdrs

candidates.description: the closest human V and J germlines, best first

germline.description: the V and J alleles the frameworks came from

identity.description: percent identity of the grafted domain to the parental one
